# Cattr

> Cattr is an open-source, self-hosted time tracking platform with activity tracking, screenshots, reporting, and extensions.

Website: https://cattr.app/

## User documentation

- [User Guide](https://cattr.app/manual/): Installation, configuration, administration, and everyday use.

## Developer documentation

- [Developer guides (English / Русский)](https://github.com/cattr-app/server-application/blob/main/docs/developer/README.md): All guides, maintained with the server source code.
- [Developers](https://cattr.app/developers/): Documentation and source-code entry point.
- [API Reference](https://cattr.app/server-application/api/): HTTP API endpoints and integrations.
- [Backend Development](https://github.com/cattr-app/server-application/blob/main/docs/developer/en/backend/README.md): Laravel server extension APIs, permissions, events and filters.
- [Frontend Development](https://github.com/cattr-app/server-application/blob/main/docs/developer/en/frontend/README.md): Vue 2 modules, components and routing.

## Source code

- [Server](https://github.com/cattr-app/server-application)
- [Desktop](https://github.com/cattr-app/desktop-application)

## Community

- [Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/cattr-app/discussions)
